verdict.rationale: Whether a code-review product publishes its source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence that CodeRabbit's source is public or openly licensed. Self-hosted deployment and the OSS pledge are adjacent topics and do not show the product's own source is open.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
